audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill/Skill/Skill/Ziggs/Skill/Ziggs/Ziggs, the inverse of what the content whys say — they give level 1 to Ziggs and levels 3 through first item to Sett, which is also the packet chart.
audit.why: Ziggs out-ranges Sett at 850 with a 6s Q before Facebreaker exists, but once Sett can close, a mage with one 20s escape loses every gap he fails to keep.
audit.corrected: Ziggs / Skill / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why said Sett is the strongest level-1 auto-trader here, and phases[6].why credited Sterak's in a row that is a skill fight.
audit.why: At level 1 Sett has no ranged tool against an 850-range 6s bomb. At two items the question is only whether Sett can reach him — Bouncing Bomb at 850 and Mega Inferno Bomb at 5000 decide the stage, not durability items.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten with the real ranges and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers, and nothing recorded Short Fuse as the burst tell.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 down to 12s and is his only escape — it also launches Ziggs himself, which is why baiting it is the entire engage plan. Short Fuse carries the autoReset flag and its cooldown drops every time he casts a spell, so a Ziggs who has just thrown Q is about to hit an empowered auto.
audit.corrected: Satchel Charge cooldowns added; the Short Fuse tell added to spikes[0].

audit.why: The kit file tags Satchel Charge with percentHealth, but Riot's own description for it says only magic damage plus a knock-away — no max-health component. Per the trust-the-description rule the flag was treated as a parsing misfire and no percent-health claim was written into the page.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Ziggs on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb (Q) reaches 850 on a 6s cooldown and you have nothing at range. Level 1 is his — soak XP behind the wave and give him no free autos.

edits.before: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable. Fights are decided by whether you cash a max-grit W — track Satchel Charge and commit on the gap.
edits.after: Two items in it is a reach contest: he free-casts from 850 and Mega Inferno Bomb travels 5000. You win only if you can still reach him.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge (W): 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — his only escape, and it launches him as well as you. Bait it.

edits.before: Once you have E Facebreaker you can finally punish Ziggs — walk up behind minions, dodge his Q Bouncing Bomb, then E-pull and W him with a full Grit bar. He has no escape but W Satchel Charge, so bait that first and he's dead to your follow-up.
edits.after: Facebreaker (E) is where you punish him — walk behind minions and watch Short Fuse: his empowered auto is the wind-up tell, and every spell he casts brings it back sooner. Bait Satchel Charge, then pull and cash a full Grit bar.

notes: The chart was the inverse of its own whys in both layers. The kit's percentHealth flag on Satchel Charge contradicts Riot's description of that ability and was not written into the page.
